# MyOS Account to Account Payment

Creates and observes one MyOS account-to-account Payment Instruction. The configured payer and recipient must resolve to distinct declared MyOS accounts. Payment Setup snapshots their parties, installs the method clause and uses the shared instruction builder. The amount binding defaults to `/product/totalMinor` and instruction placement to `/payment`.

A reservation precedes transfer. Operator-confirmed instruction results establish financial outcomes; a request, local document creation or reserved amount is not a completed transfer. Named payment request connections execute inside the instruction unless explicitly sourced from the agreement. The instruction's own guarantor operations remain separate from this facade.

Configuration references: `bindings.amount` defaults to `/product/totalMinor`; `bindings.instruction` defaults to `/payment`.
